record.title: Custodia Bank
kv: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
Nothing: the request was denied in January 2023 and the denial still stands. Custodia's petition asking the Supreme Court to review the denial is pending.

events.what: Custodia applies to the Kansas City Fed for a master account.
Custodia sues the Board and Kansas City Fed over the delay.
The Board denies Custodia's application to become a member of the Federal Reserve System.
Kansas City Fed denies the master account request, applying the 2022 account guidelines.
District court rules for the Fed.
Tenth Circuit affirms: Reserve Banks may deny eligible institutions; eligibility is not entitlement.
Tenth Circuit denies rehearing.
Justice Gorsuch extends the petition deadline to July 11, 2026.
Custodia files its petition for certiorari (docketed July 14 as No. 26-62).
Amicus briefs filed Aug 12–13 (Blockchain Association; The Digital Chamber; Sen. Lummis and others).
The Board and the Kansas City Fed file briefs opposing Supreme Court review (after two deadline extensions).

open: Date Custodia received its Wyoming SPDI charter (the Tenth Circuit says only that it was before October 2020).
Will the Supreme Court grant review? Distribution for conference not yet shown on the docket as of 2026-10-19.
Exact day of the Kansas City Fed's master account denial (opinion says January 2023).
